comments.body:
There is no requirement 5.6.3 in ASVS v4.0.3, based on content I assume it is addressing 5.3.6.

If the translation is not correct, then we would like to get the correct translation as proposal, it can be assumed that we are not able to provide better one :) We recommend to cowork with the translator and find better solution for this requirement.

Also, fixing something in the translation requires regenerating all the related documents. We would like to optimize this for larger changes.
As the issue does not contain anything actionable and there is no response, I close the issue.
